author: Antonialock
body:
T cruzi Q4DSA0 is annotated to GO:0008783  agmatinase activity from PANTHER:PTN002603433
but this enzyme is GO:0050415 formimidoylglutamase activity (hutG in bacteria)
it has no agmatinase activity (EXP in 24261485)
title: agmatinase activity PANTHER:PTN002603433

author: dragon-ai-agent
source_title: Track T. cruzi Q4DSA0 — refuted agmatinase IBA, correct activity is formimidoylglutamase (geneontology/go-annotation#6384)
